Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you help me draft a schedule for a one-day saturday broadcast on Cedar FM, an independent radio station? The schedule runs from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. and should include every program listed here. The local music show is 90 minutes, the community call-in show is 60 minutes, the afternoon news roundup is 30 minutes, and the new-music hour is 60 minutes. The community call-in show is already booked from noon to 1:00 p.m.; the news roundup is fixed at 2:00 to 2:30 p.m. The local music show can start any time between 9:00 and 11:00 a.m., and the new-music hour can start any time after 10:00 a.m. but must finish by 3:00 p.m. Leave any time that isn't scheduled as open airtime, rather than filling it with another program. Don't move either fixed booking, and don't overlap programs. Please give me a proposed schedule only, with start and end times for each program or open-airtime block. Return it as a numbered checklist, with one item per block.", "output": "Create a proposed schedule for Cedar FM, an independent radio station, for a one-day Saturday broadcast running from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Include every program listed below:

- Local music show: 90 minutes; may start between 9:00 and 11:00 a.m.
- Community call-in show: 60 minutes; fixed from noon to 1:00 p.m.
- Afternoon news roundup: 30 minutes; fixed from 2:00 to 2:30 p.m.
- New-music hour: 60 minutes; may start any time after 10:00 a.m. and must finish by 3:00 p.m.

Do not move the fixed bookings or overlap programs. Leave any unscheduled time as open airtime rather than adding another program. Provide only the proposed schedule, with start and end times for every program and open-airtime block. Format it as a numbered checklist with one item per block."}]
